```{r load-gss}
library(foreign)

read.dct <- function(dct, labels.included = "yes") {
    temp <- readLines(dct)
    temp <- temp[grepl("_column", temp)]
    switch(labels.included,
           yes = {
               pattern <- "_column\\(([0-9]+)\\)\\s+([a-z0-9]+)\\s+(.*)\\s+%([0-9]+)[a-z]\\s+(.*)"
               classes <- c("numeric", "character", "character", "numeric", "character")
               N <- 5
               NAMES <- c("StartPos", "Str", "ColName", "ColWidth", "ColLabel")
           },
           no = {
               pattern <- "_column\\(([0-9]+)\\)\\s+([a-z0-9]+)\\s+(.*)\\s+%([0-9]+).*"
               classes <- c("numeric", "character", "character", "numeric")
               N <- 4
               NAMES <- c("StartPos", "Str", "ColName", "ColWidth")
           })
    temp_metadata <- setNames(lapply(1:N, function(x) {
        out <- gsub(pattern, paste("\\", x, sep = ""), temp)
        out <- gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", out)
        out <- gsub('\"', "", out, fixed = TRUE)
        class(out) <- classes[x]; out }), NAMES)
    temp_metadata[["ColName"]] <- make.names(gsub("\\s", "", temp_metadata[["ColName"]]))
    temp_metadata
}

read.dat <- function(dat, metadata_var, labels.included = "yes") {
    read.table(dat, col.names = metadata_var[["ColName"]])
}

GSS_metadata <- read.dct("data/GSS.dct")
GSS_ascii <- read.dat("data/GSS.dat", GSS_metadata)
attr(GSS_ascii, "col.label") <- GSS_metadata[["ColLabel"]]
gss <- GSS_ascii |> janitor::clean_names()
```

```{r}
gss <- gss |>
  mutate(
    ab_support = case_when(
      abany == 1 ~ 1,
      abany == 2 ~ 0,
      abany < 0  ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    post_dobbs = if_else(year == 2022, 1, 0),
    gender = case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Men",
      sex == 2 ~ "Women",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    party = case_when(
      partyid %in% 0:2 ~ "Democrat",
      partyid == 3 ~ "Independent",
      partyid %in% 4:6 ~ "Republican",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    religiosity = case_when(
      attend <= 2 ~ "Low",
      attend <= 5 ~ "Moderate",
      attend >= 6 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

table(gss$year, gss$ab_support, useNA = "always")
```

```{r clean-ces}
ces <- ces |>
  mutate(
    # Main outcome: cc22_332a = abortion access, 1=support, 2=oppose
    ab_support = case_when(
      cc22_332a == 1 ~ 1,
      cc22_332a == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Gender (keeping Man/Woman only for comparability with GSS)
    gender = case_when(
      gender4 == 1 ~ "Men",
      gender4 == 2 ~ "Women",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Party: pid3 is 1=Dem, 2=Rep, 3=Ind, 4=Other, 5=Not sure
    party = case_when(
      pid3 == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      pid3 == 2 ~ "Republican",
      pid3 == 3 ~ "Independent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Religiosity: pew_religimp 1=Very important, 2=Somewhat, 
    #              3=Not too important, 4=Not at all important
    religiosity = case_when(
      pew_religimp == 1 ~ "High",
      pew_religimp == 2 ~ "Moderate",
      pew_religimp %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

table(ces$ab_support, useNA = "always")
```

```{r ces-subgroup}
# CES overall (this is all post-Dobbs since survey was Oct-Nov 2022)
cat("CES 2022 (post-Dobbs) overall support:", 
    round(mean(ces$ab_support, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# CES subgroup breakdown
ces_gender <- ces |>
  filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(gender)) |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  summarise(mean_support = mean(ab_support),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ces_party <- ces |>
  filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(party)) |>
  group_by(party) |>
  summarise(mean_support = mean(ab_support),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ces_relig <- ces |>
  filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(religiosity)) |>
  group_by(religiosity) |>
  summarise(mean_support = mean(ab_support),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(ces_gender)
print(ces_party)
print(ces_relig)
```

```{r overall-comparison}
# Mean support by year
overall <- gss |>
  filter(!is.na(ab_support)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    mean_support = mean(ab_support),
    n = n(),
    se = sd(ab_support) / sqrt(n)
  )

print(overall)

# is the difference statistically significant?
t.test(ab_support ~ post_dobbs, data = gss)
```

```{r subgroup-analysis}
subgroup_comparison <- function(data, group_var) {
  data |>
    filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(.data[[group_var]])) |>
    group_by(year, .data[[group_var]]) |>
    summarise(
      mean_support = mean(ab_support),
      n = n(),
      se = sd(ab_support) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = year,
      values_from = c(mean_support, n, se),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) |>
    mutate(difference = mean_support_2022 - mean_support_2021)
}

gender_table <- subgroup_comparison(gss, "gender")
party_table <- subgroup_comparison(gss, "party")
relig_table <- subgroup_comparison(gss, "religiosity")

print(gender_table)
print(party_table)
print(relig_table)
```

```{r figures, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Figure 1: Overall before/after
overall |>
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_support, fill = year)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_support - 1.96*se,
                    ymax = mean_support + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0.5, 0.65),
                     oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2021" = "#b8d4e8", "2022" = "#2166ac")) +
  labs(title = "Support for Abortion Access Before and After Dobbs",
       subtitle = "GSS 2021 vs. 2022",
       x = "Year", y = "Share Supporting Access",
       caption = "Note: Error bars = 95% CI. p = 0.21.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Figure 2: Subgroup shifts - one panel per category
subgroup_long <- bind_rows(
  gss |> filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(gender)) |>
    mutate(group = gender, category = "Gender"),
  gss |> filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(party)) |>
    mutate(group = party, category = "Party"),
  gss |> filter(!is.na(ab_support), !is.na(religiosity)) |>
    mutate(group = religiosity, category = "Religiosity")
) |>
  group_by(category, group, year) |>
  summarise(mean_support = mean(ab_support), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(subgroup_long, aes(x = factor(year), y = mean_support,
           color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = subgroup_long |> filter(year == 2022),
            aes(label = group),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~category) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0.25, 0.95)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.5))) +
  labs(title = "Abortion Support by Subgroup Before and After Dobbs",
       subtitle = "GSS 2021 vs. 2022",
       x = "Year", y = "Share Supporting Access",
       caption = "Source: General Social Survey") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r ces-gss-comparison}
comparison <- tibble(
  Group = c("Overall", "Men", "Women", 
            "Democrat", "Independent", "Republican",
            "High Religiosity", "Moderate Religiosity", "Low Religiosity"),
  GSS_2021 = c(56.4, 54.9, 58.3,
               75.7, 44.3, 33.7,
               29.7, 52.4, 70.2),
  GSS_2022 = c(58.9, 57.6, 59.9,
               81.7, 56.4, 29.6,
               30.7, 54.0, 72.4),
  CES_2022 = c(63.7, 58.9, 67.6,
               86.9, 60.8, 31.7,
               41.6, 63.7, 82.0)
) |>
  mutate(
    GSS_change = GSS_2022 - GSS_2021
  )

comparison |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Group = "Group",
    GSS_2021 = "GSS 2021 (pre)",
    GSS_2022 = "GSS 2022 (post)",
    GSS_change = "GSS Change",
    CES_2022 = "CES 2022 (post)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(GSS_2021, GSS_2022, CES_2022, GSS_change),
             decimals = 1,
             suffix = "%") |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Abortion Support Before and After Dobbs",
    subtitle = "GSS 2021 vs. 2022 and CES 2022"
  ) |>
  tab_row_group(label = "Religiosity", rows = 7:9) |>
  tab_row_group(label = "Party", rows = 4:6) |>
  tab_row_group(label = "Gender", rows = 2:3) |>
  tab_row_group(label = "Overall", rows = 1)
```
